reply_text:
Bettina, I can't set up this recurring digest. I have no scheduling tool here, so I can't make a post go out every Monday at 08:00. Nothing is scheduled yet.

Also, your message is dated Wednesday, October 14, and today is Saturday, October 24. "Starting next Monday" could mean October 19 or October 26. Please confirm which Monday you want.

Until a scheduled job exists, I can pull a "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand whenever you ask. It would cover the past week's posts from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. Finance figures such as prices, rates and contract values would stay out of the channel post. Whoever sets up the schedule should know that rule, and I'd need approval from Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark to include them.
